movement_strategy.explanation: This session prioritises shoulder range and stability, with secondary attention to thoracic mobility to support overhead and reaching movements. Limited overhead reach observed — adding shoulder and thoracic extension work. Desk/office patterns observed — adding shoulder and thoracic counter-movements. Thoracic stiffness detected — increasing thoracic mobilisation work.

assessments.name: Overhead Reach Test
assessments.instruction: Stand tall and slowly reach both arms overhead. Observe how far the arms travel before the ribs flare or the lower back arches. Note symmetry between left and right.
what_to_watch: Asymmetry between left and right arm path
Rib flare before arms reach vertical

assessments.name: Shoulder Rotation Check
assessments.instruction: Stand with arms at 90 degrees of abduction, elbows bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the arms outward (external rotation) and inward (internal rotation). Observe range and quality of movement.
what_to_watch: Limited external rotation compared to internal rotation
Pain or clicking during arc of motion

journey.purpose: Assess baseline and prepare the body

exercises.name: Standing Roll Down
movement_objectives: Release tension in the posterior chain
teaching_cues: Nod the chin and let the head lead the descent
Bend the knees slightly if the hamstrings limit the movement
Roll up from the base of the spine — stack each vertebra
exercises.progression: Close eyes or slow the tempo for proprioceptive challenge

exercises.name: Arm Raise
teaching_cues: Inhale to float the arms up — exhale to lower
Keep the ribs knitted together — avoid arching the lower back
Reach through the fingertips — lengthen before you lift
exercises.progression: Add light weights or slow the tempo

journey.purpose: Warm up and mobilize target systems

exercises.name: Footwork
teaching_cues: Press through the whole foot — feel all ten toes
Keep the pelvis neutral as the carriage moves
Knees track over the second and third toes
exercises.progression: Increase spring resistance or add single-leg variations

exercises.name: Mermaid
movement_objectives: Open the side body and intercostals
Promote breath expansion into the side ribs
teaching_cues: Lengthen both sides of the waist — avoid collapsing into the bottom side
Press the carriage away from the shoulder, not the hand
Inhale to lengthen, exhale to deepen the side bend
exercises.progression: Add arm variations or increase lateral range

exercises.name: Pelvic Curl
teaching_cues: Peel the spine off the mat one vertebra at a time
Exhale to roll up, inhale at the top, exhale to roll down
Press evenly through both feet — avoid dominance on one side
exercises.progression: Add single-leg bridge or increase spring tension

exercises.name: Feet in Straps
movement_objectives: Increase hip range of motion in multiple planes
Challenge pelvic stability during dynamic leg movement
teaching_cues: Keep the pelvis anchored to the mat as the legs move
Move from the hip joint — avoid gripping the lower back
Maintain even spring tension — control the return
exercises.regression: Reduce strap range or use lighter springs
exercises.progression: Increase range of motion or slow down the tempo

exercises.name: Mermaid on Chair
movement_objectives: Mobilise lateral flexion of the spine
teaching_cues: Sit evenly on both sit bones before you begin
Press the pedal with the shoulder, not the wrist
exercises.progression: Add arm reaches or combine with rotation

Press straight down — avoid leaning forward
